title: Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity
summary: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity.
